entities.summary: Anti-environmentalism is a set of ideas and actions that oppose environmentalism as a whole or specific environmental policies or environmental initiatives. Criticism of environmentalism originates from multiple ideologies, interest groups, and political objectives. Oppositions can take the form of an organized countermovement, aimed at scientific claims about climate change, environmental policies and regulations, in both national or international spheres. Anti-environmentalist actors may include workers in industries and companies that are threatened by environmental policies, and anti-environmentalist think tanks.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Anti-environmentalism has had a significant impact on shaping public policy and discourse around environmental issues, particularly in the United States. Since the 1970s, anti-environmental groups have contributed to the rollback of environmental regulations, such as the Clean Air Act and the Endangered Species Act, resulting in increased greenhouse gas emissions and biodiversity loss.
